newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes flat in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes flat in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0221 to the dollar in bland trade in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In late afternoon, Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0220 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.

Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of $190 million. Dealers speculated that $140 million from a finacial buy transaction by a state development bank helped create the large surplus.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0279 to the dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.1 percent to end at 1.040 per greenback, traders said.
